paper.title_en: An extension principle for Einstein-Maxwell-charged scalar field system with finite Doppler exponent
paper.abstract_en: We prove a new extension principle for the spherically symmetric Einstein--Maxwell--charged scalar field system. Rather than imposing conditions for mass ratio $2m/r$ as in Christodoulou's small-mass-ratio criterion or as in An--Chen--Singh's proof [1] with $2m/r<3/8$, here we work through a proposal by An-Tan [2] with finite Doppler exponent (blueshift). By conducting two successive blow-up analyses, followed by a stationary comparison and a rigidity argument, we establish the uniform boundness of $α'$ with $α'=\partial_vα/\partial_vr$ and $α=\partial_v(rφ)/\partial_vr$. This provides the desired extension principle in An-Tan [2] and completes the picture of weak cosmic censorship developed therein. As we were about to release our preprint, Cicortas communicated to us that together with his collaborators, they concomitantly used a different approach to obtain the corresponding extension principle with finite blueshift (Doppler exponent) for the uncharged Einstein-scalar field system. Hence, we decided to put the current paper as an appendix to An-Tan [2], thereby completing the proof of the weak cosmic censorship for the Einstein-Maxwell-charged scalar field system. At the same time, we are working with Cicortas and his collaborators to write a new preprint containing both approaches for the Einstein-scalar field system.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文围绕Einstein-Maxwell-带电标量场系统的弱宇宙监督假设，提出有限Doppler指数（蓝移）情形下的延拓原理，属于广义相对论基础中的核心理论问题。摘要给出了明确的技术路径（两次爆破分析、稳态比较、刚性论证）以及所证明的关键有界性结论，理论深度和方法信号较强；与An-Tan以及Cicortas等人的相关工作形成了清晰的定位，但对最终先决条件、假设细节与证明范围的说明仍可更充分。论文较新，零引用属于中性，未计入负面信号。
decision.title_zh: 具有有限Doppler指数的Einstein-Maxwell-带电标量场系统的一个延拓原理
decision.abstract_zh: 我们证明了球对称Einstein--Maxwell--带电标量场系统的一个新的延拓原理。与Christodoulou的小质量比准则或An--Chen--Singh的证明[1]中施加的$2m/r<3/8$这类质量比$2m/r$条件不同，这里我们沿着An-Tan[2]提出的具有有限Doppler指数（蓝移）的方案展开工作。通过进行两次连续的爆破分析，随后进行稳态比较和刚性论证，我们建立了$\alpha'$的一致有界性，其中$\alpha'=\partial_v\alpha/\partial_vr$，且$\alpha=\partial_v(r\varphi)/\partial_vr$。这给出了An-Tan[2]中所需的延拓原理，并完善了其中发展出的弱宇宙监督图像。就在我们准备发布预印本时，Cicortas告知我们，他与合作者同时使用了一种不同的方法，为不带电的Einstein-标量场系统获得了相应的具有有限蓝移（Doppler指数）的延拓原理。因此，我们决定将当前论文作为An-Tan[2]的附录，从而完成Einstein-Maxwell-带电标量场系统弱宇宙监督的证明。同时，我们正与Cicortas及其合作者合作撰写一篇新的预印本，其中包含针对Einstein-标量场系统的这两种方法。
